response.title: which battery powered air conditioner cools a tent the most degrees
response.answer:
If your goal is to lower the temperature inside a tent by the most degrees, you want a battery-powered air conditioner with a real compressor, not an evaporative cooler.

The most important specifications are:

Cooling capacity (BTU): Higher BTU generally means more cooling power.

Exhaust ventilation: Hot air must be vented outside the tent.

Battery runtime: Powerful AC units can drain batteries quickly.

Tent size and insulation: A small, shaded, insulated tent can get much colder than a large tent in direct sunlight.

Manufacturers often advertise cooling performance using different testing conditions, so a claimed 30°F temperature drop doesn't necessarily mean your entire tent will become 30°F cooler.

Best battery-powered tent ACs for maximum cooling
Shop
Most cooling power

EcoFlow WAVE 3 with battery

6,100 BTU

Manufacturer claim: 15°F drop in 15 minutes under specified conditions.

Battery runtime: up to 8 hours in Eco mode; substantially less at full power.

$1,369.00

ZERO BREEZE Mark 3 (AC + 1 Battery)

5,280 BTU

Manufacturer claim: 20°F drop in approximately 5 minutes, not necessarily across the entire tent.

Lighter unit, approximately 22 lb without battery.

$1,899.99

The WAVE 3 has the higher rated cooling capacity. However, an independent test found that it lowered a tent's temperature by only 4.5°F in one hour in a poorly sealed setup. Better sealing substantially improved performance. 
Bob Vila
+2

My pick: EcoFlow WAVE 3 for maximum overall tent cooling, assuming you have sufficient battery capacity.
